rules: copied: the value of the key in the file. line: a full line of a CI job log in the CI record. derived: a formula over other values. A key part in brackets selects one list item by its fields.
text: the form that docs/decisions/s3b-exit.md shows. A ratio has 3 digits; a commit has 7 characters.

criteria.text: STONES.md S3b exit: the S1 harness and the S2 benchmarks run sqll through its adapters.
STONES.md S3b exit: the interfaces are documented.
STONES.md S3b exit: after S3b, each change to the core goes through the Core track.
CONSTITUTION.md G3 (keep the S3 speed): the S3b changes together, from the S3 exit to the S3b exit head.

interfaces.why: a rule reads its settings from the config (the Rule trait has its config keys; docs/interfaces/rules.md)

interfaces.stones: tree to schema for code generation

bullets.bullet: A code layout with one package for each part

interfaces.rows.formula: count of the rows of the index

interfaces.mapped.formula: count of the rows that map to a STONES interface

exit.interfaces.formula: each row of the index maps to one STONES interface, and the document and the test of each row exist

bullets.ok.formula: each bullet is in STONES.md, S3b, and each of its documents and tests exists

probe.tracks.formula: count of the tracks other than core

probe.fail_without_label.formula: count of the runs without the label that fail (exit code 1) and name the path as owned by core

probe.pass_with_label.formula: count of the runs with the label that pass and ask for a core review

probe.control_pass.formula: count of the control runs (the status file of the track) that pass

exit.core_track.formula: probe.fail_without_label == probe.pass_with_label == probe.core_runs, and each control run passes

speed.no_reason.formula: the slower benchmarks with no reason in REASONS

g3.met.formula: speed.failure == 0, each slower benchmark has a reason, HEAD is faster than sqlfluff on 112 of 112 and faster than sqruff on 108 of 108 pairs
